name: openbb_fixedincome_effr
description:
Effective federal funds rate (percent) history through the OpenBB Platform (obb.fixedincome.rate.effr), in OpenBB's default date window.
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol (accepted by the schema, ignored by this command); provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts federal_reserve or fred; schema default fmp (also rejected), but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it); federal_reserve needs no key.
Other sources: av_fed_funds_rate, fred_fed_funds_rate; SOFR: openbb_fixedincome_sofr. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"provider": "federal_reserve"}
